dialogues.title: First day at the office
dialogues.context: Yeni işindeki ilk günün. Mutfakta bir iş arkadaşınla karşılaştın.

lines.en: Morning! I don't think we've met. I'm Dana.
alternatives: Hi there — are you new? I'm Dana.

lines.en: I'm Baris, nice to meet you. I started today.
lines.tr: Ben Barış, tanıştığımıza memnun oldum. Bugün başladım.
alternatives: Hi Dana, I'm Baris — today's my first day.

lines.en: Welcome! What do you do?
alternatives: Nice! Which team are you on?

lines.en: I work in software — mostly mobile apps.
lines.tr: Yazılım tarafındayım, daha çok mobil uygulamalar.
alternatives: I'm a developer, on the mobile team.

lines.en: Nice. I'm in marketing, just down the hall.
alternatives: Cool — I'm in marketing, right down there.

lines.en: I'm new here — do you know where the kitchen is?
lines.tr: Buraya yeniyim, mutfak nerede biliyor musun?
alternatives: Sorry, still finding my way — where's the coffee?

lines.en: You're standing in it! Coffee's fresh, help yourself.
alternatives: This is it! Grab a cup, it's just been made.

lines.en: Thanks a lot. How long have you been here?
lines.tr: Çok teşekkürler. Sen ne zamandır buradasın?
alternatives: Appreciate it. Have you been here long?

lines.en: About three years now. Time flies!
lines.tr: Üç yıl kadar oldu. Zaman su gibi akıyor!
alternatives: Three years — feels like yesterday.

lines.en: How's work going? Busy team?
lines.tr: İşler nasıl gidiyor? Ekip yoğun mu?
alternatives: Is it usually this busy?

lines.en: Busy, but good. Anyway, I should get going.
lines.tr: Yoğun ama iyi. Neyse, ben kaçayım.
alternatives: Always busy — anyway, I've got a meeting.

lines.en: Sure. It was nice meeting you.
alternatives: Of course — nice to meet you, Dana.

dialogues.title: The Monday stand-up
dialogues.context: Haftalık online ekip toplantısındasın. Durum raporu vereceksin ve bir gecikmeyi bildireceksin.

lines.en: Alright, everyone's here — let's get started.
alternatives: Okay, let's kick off.

lines.en: Baris, can everyone hear me?
alternatives: Is my audio okay for everyone?

lines.en: Loud and clear. Sorry — you're on mute now.
lines.tr: Gayet net. Pardon, şimdi mikrofonunuz kapalı.
alternatives: We can hear you fine. — Oh, you're muted.

lines.en: There we go. How's the login screen coming along?
lines.tr: Tamam şimdi oldu. Giriş ekranı ne durumda?
alternatives: Better? Right — where are we with the login work?

lines.en: Let me share my screen.
alternatives: I'll show you — sharing now.

lines.en: The design is done, but testing is behind.
lines.tr: Tasarım bitti ama testler geride kaldı.
alternatives: Design's finished — testing is running late though.

lines.en: How far behind are we talking?
alternatives: How late is late?

lines.en: Two days. I'm swamped this week.
lines.tr: İki gün. Bu hafta işlere boğuldum.
alternatives: About two days — my week is packed.

lines.en: Fair enough. What's the deadline again?
alternatives: Okay. Remind me of the deadline?

lines.en: End of day Thursday.
alternatives: Thursday, close of business.

lines.en: Who's taking the lead on the testing?
alternatives: Who owns the testing side?

lines.en: I'll take care of it, but I could use another pair of hands.
lines.tr: Ben hallederim ama bir yardımcıya ihtiyacım var.
alternatives: That's me — though some help would speed it up.

lines.en: I'll ask Dana. Let's wrap up — I'll send out the notes.
alternatives: I'll get Dana on it. That's time — notes to follow.

dialogues.title: Disagreeing in a meeting
dialogues.context: Bir iş arkadaşın erken bir lansman tarihi öneriyor. Katılmıyorsun ama ilişkiyi bozmadan itiraz etmelisin.

lines.en: So I think we should launch in March.
alternatives: My proposal is a March launch.

lines.en: Could I jump in here?
alternatives: Sorry, can I come in on that?

lines.en: Of course, go ahead.
alternatives: Please do.

lines.en: I see your point, but the timeline is too tight.
lines.tr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama takvim çok sıkışık.
alternatives: I understand the reasoning — I just think March is too soon.

lines.en: We've done tighter before, though.
alternatives: We've managed worse deadlines.

lines.en: That's a good point. Testing was the problem then too, though.
lines.tr: İyi bir nokta. Ama o zaman da sorun testlerdi.
alternatives: True — but testing slipped that time as well.

lines.en: So what are you suggesting?
alternatives: What would you do instead?

lines.en: How about May instead? Six extra weeks.
lines.tr: Onun yerine mayıs olsa? Altı hafta fazladan.
alternatives: Why don't we aim for May?

lines.en: Marketing won't like that.
alternatives: Marketing has already announced March.

lines.en: Let's meet in the middle — April, with a soft launch.
lines.tr: Ortada buluşalım: nisan, sınırlı bir lansmanla.
alternatives: What about April, but we start small?

lines.en: That could work. Let's take this offline with Dana.
lines.tr: Bu olabilir. Bunu Dana'yla toplantı dışında konuşalım.
alternatives: I could live with that — let's discuss it with Dana after.

lines.en: Just to be clear — April, soft launch. Are we on the same page?
lines.tr: Netleştirelim: nisan, sınırlı lansman. Aynı fikirde miyiz?
alternatives: So April with a soft launch — agreed?

lines.en: Agreed. I'll get back to you on the numbers.
alternatives: Yes. I'll send you the figures later.

dialogues.title: Asking for time off
dialogues.context: Gelecek ay bir hafta izin almak istiyorsun ama yoğun bir döneme denk geliyor.

lines.en: Do you have a minute?
alternatives: Have you got a moment?

lines.en: Sure, what's up?
alternatives: Of course — everything okay?

lines.en: I'd like to take a week off next month.
lines.tr: Gelecek ay bir hafta izin almak istiyorum.
alternatives: I wanted to ask about taking some leave next month.

lines.en: Which week were you thinking?
alternatives: Any particular dates?

lines.en: The second week — my family's visiting.
alternatives: The 8th to the 15th, if that works.

lines.en: That's right before the launch. That's tricky.
alternatives: Hmm, that's launch week minus one. Difficult.

lines.en: I know the timing isn't great.
alternatives: I realize it's a busy period.

lines.en: I'd finish the testing before I go.
alternatives: Everything on my plate would be done first.

lines.en: And if something breaks while you're away?
lines.tr: Peki sen yokken bir şey bozulursa?
alternatives: Who covers if there's a problem?

lines.en: Dana could cover. I'd walk her through it beforehand.
lines.tr: Dana bakabilir. Önceden ona adım adım anlatırım.
alternatives: Dana knows the system — I'd brief her fully.

lines.en: That works for me. Put it in the system.
alternatives: Alright, I'm fine with that — log it officially.

lines.en: I really appreciate it. Thanks.
alternatives: Thank you — that's a big help.
